subject: general
question: Which is the only surviving specimen of the ancient Sanskrit theatre recognised by UNESCO as a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kutiyattam.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kutiyattam or Koodiyattam, **which literally means **combined acting, **is a form of traditional Sanskrit theatre about 2,000 years old. 
 
• **UNESCO **declared Kutiyattam as a **Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity in 2001.**
